candidate_relations.reason: Giant-cell granuloma is a different jaw lucency and was not among the stated radiographic differentials of OKC, radicular cyst, and unicystic ameloblastoma.
Periapical actinomycosis is the reference diagnosis for the irregular periapical lucency engulfing a previously root-treated molar.
Surgical ciliated cyst follows maxillary sinus surgery, whereas this lesion is mandibular around premolar-molar apices.
Bone cyst captures the unilocular mandibular lucency but not periapical actinomycosis.
Tender percussion and a lucency around an endodontically treated molar indicate periapical infection, the parent of actinomycosis.

case_quality_flags: Only imaging is provided; no histopathology or culture confirming actinomycosis appears in the record.
